_about: Demo and review videos per tool, pulled monthly (see lib/evidence/REFRESH.md). kind: vendor (made by the company) | independent (a creator with no visible tie to the company) | comparison (a side-by-side test). verified=false means the label comes from the title or playlist and the channel has not yet been confirmed. year is the year the title or listing states, null if unknown. featured=true puts it in the guide's 'Watch before you pay' row. Every video is checked against YouTube's embed endpoint (scripts/check-videos.mjs): it must exist and allow playback on other sites, so it plays here instead of sending people to YouTube. channel is the uploader as YouTube reports it; kind is checked against it.
